profile.headline: Solution-Driven Engineering Leader | Builder of High-Velocity Teams | The Bridge Between Deep Code & Execution
profile.summary:
Results-driven technology leader with 20+ years of experience, adept at wearing multiple hats—Manager, Product Owner, Technical Lead, and Support champion—to deliver complex, high-impact solutions. Proven in leading cross-functional teams, aligning technology with business goals, and driving operational excellence, scalability, and innovation.

     Currently leading a Data Science team at Cox Communications, leveraging PMP-certified project management expertise to deliver data-driven solutions and streamline end-to-end delivery. Experience spans automotive, telecommunications, and healthcare industries, bringing a well-rounded perspective to technical leadership and project execution. Passionate about building high-performing, collaborative teams that drive measurable business value.

positions.title: Manager, Data Science
positions.description:
* Lead Data Science and Analytics delivery for Service Health, Network Intelligence, and Reliability platforms, driving solutions that improve network operations and customer experience.
* Manage and mentor a distributed team of 12-14 data scientists and analytics engineers across onshore and nearshore locations, fostering a high-performance engineering culture.
* Own end-to-end product  delivery as Engineering Manager, Product Owner, and Technical Lead, setting technical strategy, architecture direction, roadmap prioritization, and execution.
* Architect and deliver large-scale, event-driven data platforms processing customer, network, and  telemetry data to enable real-time monitoring, predictive insights, outage management, and operational analytics.
* Led modernization  initiatives including Kafka-based event streaming, cloud-native AWS/EKS deployments, CI/CD adoption, and retirement of legacy integrations.
* Delivered telemetry-driven platforms that reduced truck rolls and improved customer experience through CPE telemetry processing, network health monitoring, and centralized event management.
Partner closely with Network Analytics, Reliability Engineering, Operations, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Drive platform reliability and operational excellence through proactive monitoring, data quality improvements, technical debt reduction, production support, and continuous process automation.
Successfully led Agile delivery across multiple product pods, overseeing backlog management, architecture reviews, release readiness, stakeholder communication, and engineering mentorship.

positions.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
positions.description:
* As SME for polling applications, Architect and Design complete solution for polling applications using Python and latest technologies
* Developed and Design jenkin pipelines for Dockerized multi VMs based application.
* Used latest technologies for logging  (new relic, splunk, DB),
    monitoring Dockers (Portainer),
    VM based deployment (Docker , Docker Service, Docker swarm),
    Configurable application more like ( Openshift, Kubernate  way)
* Provided technical assistance and mentoring to SE I team members
* Leading and guiding offshore and onshore DEV, QA and support team to support polling applications better way.
* Installed and created cluster for Kafka for communications between multiple applications
* Day to day learning for on networking snmp protocols.
* Created applications and pipelines for work for Openshift as well as RDC VMs.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
* Developed Data Services related enhancement/defects stories in Agile Environment. 
* worked on AWS Services EC2, EMR,S3, Glue, lambda, SQS, SNS, CloudWatch, terraform etc on daily basis.
* Developed lambda functions for triggering application in EMR and controlling complete data service flow.
* Developed jenkin pipeline for ETL applications, on AWS beanstalk
* worked on front end layer enhancements using react redux , service layer using jooq.
* Developed spark scala ETL applications for AWS cloud.
* Informatica 9.5/ BDE wf development.
* worked on Big Data related technologies.
* worked on Oracle, Netezza DB server to create storeprocs and day to day backend activities.
* Set up Environments (QA, DEV, Prod), Team Training and documentation on ETLvalidator tool.
